author: TeIq
content:
**Design doc**: .design/mod-policy-workbook.md
**Implements**: REQ-D1..D4; AC-5

**Files to add**:
- polaris-frontend/src/pages/admin_policies.rs (two-pane admin edit)
- polaris-frontend/src/pages/policies.rs (read-only browse)
- polaris-frontend/styles/admin-policies.css

**Files to modify**:
- polaris-frontend/src/navigation.rs — routes + admin nav link
- polaris-frontend/src/api_client/{dto,mod,native,wasm}.rs

**UI**:
- Two-pane layout (mirror /admin/moderators)
- decision_criteria: textarea + Edit/Preview tab (REQ-D2; no live side-by-side)
- Autonomy tab admin-only (mode + action-kinds + thresholds + pause state)
- Version-history panel with change_summary + per-version diff links

**Rust quality**:
- All colours via var(--…) — styles_tokens forbids literal hex outside tokens.css
- WCAG 2.x AA contrast — styles_contrast enforces
- BEM naming (admin-policies__row, --cell--name, etc.)
- styles_coverage requires every selector referenced from Rust have a matching rule in CSS

**Tests**: styles_coverage, styles_tokens, styles_contrast all pass

**Blocked by**: #225
